les: Van 'n stil plaas tot 'n besige stad
kaps_punt: Plekke om te woon op plaas, boeredorpie, dorp, stad

items.bewering: Van 'n stil plaas tot 'n besige stad
items.bron: Contrast holds: Stats SA Census 2022 densities (Wikipedia table built from Stats SA: Gauteng 831/km2 vs Northern Cape 3.64/km2); INRIX 2025 / TomTom congestion for Cape Town and Johannesburg (IOL Cape Argus, 17 Apr 2026). The title is a relative contrast, not an absolute claim.

items.bewering: Geografie bestudeer mense en die plekke waar hulle woon en werk. Dit bestudeer ook die natuur: die land, die water en die lug.
items.bron: Physical geography covers geosphere, hydrosphere and atmosphere (worldatlas.com 'What are the two main branches of geography'; Dictionary.com and Merriam-Webster 'physical geography'); human geography covers people, places and activities (Oxford Learner's Dictionaries 'human geography'); RGS (rgs.org/about): geography bridges the social and natural sciences. Note: the colon list omits living things (biogeography); incomplete, not false.

items.bewering: Twee van sy baie takke is Fisiese Geografie en Menslike Geografie.
items.bron: worldatlas.com 'What Are the Two Main Branches of Geography?'; Wikipedia 'Human geography'. Both names are correct. Observation, not a fault: sources usually call these the two MAIN branches, of which the many sub-fields are parts; 'two of its many branches' is true but does not tell the learner they are the main two.

items.bewering: Fisiese Geografie bestudeer hoe die natuur lyk en werk.
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries 'physical geography' (natural features of the earth's surface); GEMET thesaurus (phenomena of the Earth's physical environment); Dictionary.com (natural features and phenomena: landforms, drainage, climate, soils, vegetation). 'Lyk' = features, 'werk' = processes.

items.bewering: Menslike Geografie bestudeer wat mense doen en hoe hulle die aarde verander.
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries 'human geography': study of how human activity affects or is affected by the surface of the earth; Wikipedia 'Human geography' (how human actions modify the natural environment).

items.bewering: Geografie vra keer op keer waar iets is en hoekom dit juis daar is.
items.bron: Manitoba Education social studies framework tn-11 ('Where is it located? Why is it where it is?'); LibreTexts / Saylor 'World Regional Geography 1.1 The Where and the Why'; Arizona Geographic Alliance five themes.

items.bewering: 'n Plek waar 'n groep mense saam woon, noem ons 'n nedersetting.
items.bron: Internet Geography 'What is a settlement?' (a place where people live; from a few houses to a city); EPFL Graph Search 'Settlement' (a community in which people live; hamlets, villages, towns, cities).

items.bewering: 'n Plek waar 'n groep mense saam woon.
items.bron: As the item above (Internet Geography; EPFL Graph Search). Read alone it is accurate and matches the study text word for word.

items.bewering: Op 'n plaas staan die huise ver uit mekaar op baie oop grond.
items.bron: Stats SA Census of Commercial Agriculture 2017 (statssa.gov.za/?p=13144): 40 122 commercial farming units on 46.4 million ha, of which 36.5 million ha grazing - roughly 1 150 ha per unit on average (derived); dispersed rural settlement in settlement-hierarchy sources (savemyexams CIE settlement hierarchy).

items.bewering: Party plase hou net beeste of skape aan, en ander plant net gewasse. Baie plase doen albei op dieselfde grond.
items.bron: Stats SA CoCA 2017 (grazing 36.5 m ha vs arable 7.6 m ha, so livestock-only and crop farms both exist); Farmer's Weekly 'Mixed farming: key to livestock success for Free State farmer'; Thornton & Herrero 2015 (CSIRO) on mixed crop-livestock systems on the same farm in sub-Saharan Africa incl. South Africa.

items.bewering: Bure woon dikwels kilometers uit mekaar en help mekaar met veiligheid en in noodgevalle.
items.bron: Distance: Stats SA CoCA 2017 (average ~1 150 ha, about 11 km2, per commercial unit - derived). Mutual help, South African sources: Western Cape Government news on farm watches; Farmer's Weekly 'Teamwork: farmers' strongest weapon against crime'; Redelinghuys Farm Watch handles crime patrols, veld fires and first aid at accidents; Fire Protection Associations under the National Veld and Forest Fire Act (IOL 23 Oct 2024; Santam).

items.bewering: 'n Stuk grond waar mense diere aanhou of die land bewerk.
items.bron: Consistent with dictionary sense of farm (land used for growing crops and/or keeping animals) and with the mixed/livestock/crop evidence above (Stats SA CoCA 2017; Farmer's Weekly). 'Of' reads inclusively, so it does not exclude mixed farms.

items.bewering: 'n Boeredorpie is 'n klein groepie huise tussen die plase. Daar woon min mense, en daar is min winkels en dienste.
items.bron: Settlement hierarchy: villages are small, with few low-order services (savemyexams CIE IGCSE/O Level 'Settlement & Services Hierarchy'; Internet Geography). No Afrikaans dictionary entry for 'boeredorp(ie)' was found online; the claim is checked against the English 'farming village' concept.

items.bewering: Die mense van die dorpie en die plase rondom deel sy winkels en sy skool.
items.bron: Sphere of influence of a village serving its surrounding area (savemyexams CIE settlement hierarchy). South African practice: farm children commonly attend schools in nearby towns, increasingly since farm-school closures (Mail & Guardian 16 Mar 2016 and 3 Oct 2020; Legal Resources Centre press release on farm-school closures; SABC News on ~350 rural/farm school closures). Note: the sentence presupposes the village has a school; most do, not all.

items.bewering: Met so min mense is dit maklik om mekaar se name te ken.
items.bron: Statistics Canada General Social Survey 2005 bulletin: rural residents are more likely to know all or most of their neighbours; Iowa State University small-town studies (Besser) on close-knit small towns. International sources, but the claim is a general one about community size, not a local custom.

items.bewering: 'n Klein dorpie tussen die plase met min mense en min dienste.
items.bron: As the settlement-hierarchy sources above (savemyexams CIE). Consistent with the study block.

items.bewering: 'n Dorp is groter as 'n dorpie, en die huise staan nader aan mekaar.
items.bron: Settlement hierarchy ranks by population and built-up density from hamlet/village to town to city (savemyexams CIE 'Settlement & Services Hierarchy'; Internet Geography). Comparative, not a superlative.

items.bewering: Hier staan skole en winkels naby mekaar in die straat. Dikwels is daar ook 'n bank.
items.bron: Towns provide more and higher-order services than villages - schools, shops, banks (savemyexams CIE settlement hierarchy). 'Dikwels' is correctly hedged.

items.bewering: Mense doen ook baie meer soorte werk as op 'n plaas.
items.bron: More functions and services up the settlement hierarchy mean more kinds of employment (savemyexams CIE 'Factors influencing settlement site, growth and functions' and 'Settlement & Services Hierarchy').

items.bewering: Baie van hulle ry elke oggend werk of skool toe.
items.bron: Stats SA National Household Travel Survey 2020 (statssa.gov.za/?p=14054; SAnews 'Walking the most common mode of transport'): about 59% of learners walk all the way, so about 40% ride; 10.7 million people used taxis and 6.2 million cars in the survey week. 'Baie' (many), not 'die meeste', is true. Note: walking is the most common mode nationally, so this must not be widened to 'most'.

items.bewering: 'n Nedersetting groter as 'n dorpie, met skole, winkels en dikwels ook 'n bank.
items.bron: As the settlement-hierarchy sources above (savemyexams CIE). Consistent with the study block.

items.bewering: In 'n stad woon baie mense naby mekaar op een plek. Die geboue staan dig teen mekaar, en party is baie hoog.
items.bron: Stats SA Census 2022 densities (Wikipedia 'List of South African provinces by population density': Gauteng, the most urban province, 831/km2 vs national 50.8); settlement hierarchy (Internet Geography).

items.bewering: Baie mense werk in groot winkels, kantore en fabrieke.
items.bron: Cities host high-order services, chain stores and industry (savemyexams CIE settlement hierarchy); factory-built South African towns such as Sasolburg (sahistory.org.za 'Sasolburg').

items.bewering: Die paaie is vol motors, busse en minibus-taxi's, en die verkeer is dikwels stadig.
items.bron: IOL Cape Argus 17 Apr 2026 (INRIX 2025: Cape Town drivers lose about 96 hours a year in peak traffic); University of Johannesburg study on Johannesburg congestion with TomTom data (pure.uj.ac.za; MDPI Sustainability 14(14):8809): minibus taxis major contributors, over 66% of peak-hour public transport trips; BRT buses in Johannesburg and Cape Town.

items.bewering: 'n Baie groot nedersetting met hoë geboue, fabrieke en baie verkeer.
items.bron: As the three city items above (Stats SA density; INRIX/TomTom; settlement hierarchy). Typical features, consistent with the study block ('party is baie hoog').

items.bewering: Mense het na water gesoek en na grond waarop gewasse kan groei.
items.blok: Hoekom mense juis daar woon en hoe plekke verander
items.bron: Settlement site factors: water supply and fertile soil (savemyexams CIE 'Factors Influencing Settlement Site, Growth & Functions'; thegeoroom.co.zw 'Site and situation factors').

items.bewering: Die klimaat van 'n plek speel ook 'n groot rol in hulle keuse.
items.blok: Hoekom mense juis daar woon en hoe plekke verander
items.bron: Climate as a settlement factor - dry and very cold regions sparsely settled (savemyexams CIE settlement factors); South Africa Yearbook 2011/12, 'Land and its people' (GCIS): about 65% of the country gets under 500 mm, the usual minimum for dryland farming.

items.bewering: In die baie droë dele van ons land woon baie minder mense as in die nat dele.
items.blok: Hoekom mense juis daar woon en hoe plekke verander
items.bron: South Africa Yearbook 2011/12, 'Land and its people' (GCIS): about 21% of the country, mainly the arid west, gets under 200 mm a year; the driest place is Alexander Bay, Northern Cape. Stats SA Census 2022 (via Wikipedia table): Northern Cape 3.64 people/km2 vs national 50.8, KwaZulu-Natal 132. Comparative, not a superlative.

items.bewering: Vandag trek werk ook mense, want 'n myn of 'n fabriek laat 'n dorp groei. So kan 'n dorpie met die tyd tot 'n dorp groei.
items.blok: Hoekom mense juis daar woon en hoe plekke verander
items.bron: Mine: sahistory.org.za on Johannesburg - a mining camp of about 3 000 by August 1886 after the Langlaagte gold reef find; St John's College history - largest town in southern Africa within six years. Factory: sahistory.org.za 'Sasolburg' - town established 1954 to house Sasol plant employees. Jobs as a settlement-growth factor (savemyexams CIE). 'Vandag ... ook' does not claim work only draws people today, so it is true as written.

items.bewering: Maar as 'n dorp se myn toemaak, verloor die dorp baie van sy werk. Party mense trek dan weg om ander werk te soek.
items.blok: Hoekom mense juis daar woon en hoe plekke verander
items.bron: SABC News on Trans Hex closing the Baken mine, Richtersveld: town 'slowly turning into a ghost town, as people move out in search of new jobs'; Business Report 2016 'Ghost towns spring up as miners shafted' (Thabazimbi after Kumba Iron Ore closure); Business Report 8 Mar 2024 (Bench Marks Foundation on declining mining towns in the Free State, North West, Gauteng, Mpumalanga).

items.bewering: Op al vier plekke het mense dieselfde behoeftes, soos kos, water en skuiling.
items.bron: Maslow 1943, physiological needs (food, water, shelter at the base) as reported by several secondary sources (careers360 summary; dfblog summaries). 'Soos' marks examples, not a closed list.

items.bewering: Plante wat mense kweek vir kos en vir ander produkte.
items.bron: Wiktionary 'crop' via OneLook (a plant grown to be harvested as food, fodder, fuel or for any other economic purpose); Vocabulary.com 'crop' (cotton as a cash crop); Oxford Learner's Dictionaries 'crop' (grown in large quantities, especially as food).

opsomming: Alle 32 bewerings is nagegaan en bevestig; die les bevat geen superlatiewe en geen analogieë nie (net vergelykende stellings soos 'groter as' en 'baie minder mense as', wat ook bevestig is), en drie stellings is waar maar mag nie verbreed word nie: 'baie' mense ry werk of skool toe (nie 'die meeste' nie - stap is landwyd die algemeenste), nie elke boeredorpie het 'n skool nie, en Fisiese en Menslike Geografie word gewoonlik die twee HOOFtakke genoem.
